description: Canonical fill. Represented participant with a disposition hearing coming up on a post-2018 charge that counsel expects to be dismissed with prejudice. Only the four screening answers this track actually collects are populated. Docket/case number, OTN, county, courtroom, judge, State's Attorney identity and State's Attorney position stay blank, as do all protected fields, because no source supplies them and this track collects none of them.

screeningAnswers.hasUpcomingDisposition: Yes — a court date is coming up at which the case may be dismissed or the participant may be found not guilty
screeningAnswers.isRepresented: Yes — a public defender is on the case
screeningAnswers.offenseDateOnOrAfter2018: Yes — the arrest or charge happened on or after January 1, 2018
screeningAnswers.dismissalWithPrejudice: Counsel expects a dismissal with prejudice

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted. Under § 5.2(g) the presiding trial judge enters an order granting or denying during the same hearing; this packet states no conclusion and predicts no outcome.
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodText: None, but the petition must be filed the same day, during the disposition hearing.
additionalFacts: The petition must be filed with the circuit clerk on the same day and during the same hearing in which the case is disposed.
Section 5.2(g)(5)(A) frames the filing as made by the defendant's attorney on the defendant's behalf.
If the petition is not filed during the hearing, ordinary sealing under § 5.2(c)(3)(A) remains available at any time through il-seal-nonconv.

outsidePartyFields.prosecutorPositionNote: Blank. Whether the State's Attorney objects is an act of an outside party at a hearing that has not happened.
outsidePartyFields.counselSignatureNote: Blank. Counsel's review, adoption and signature is a required manual completion item; LegalEase never signs for counsel and never names counsel.
outsidePartyFields.serviceCompletionNote: Blank. Service is a copy handed to the State's Attorney in open court by counsel; no document here asserts that it happened.
outsidePartyFields.hearingOutcomeNote: Blank. The proposed order is an empty-outcome instrument.

attachments: Proposed Order on Petition for Immediate Sealing (component il-immediate-seal-proposed-order-2, no outcome asserted)
